2. Reason: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly identify the OpenCV version that added support for Mask-RCNN. Instead of extracting the version number from the GitHub issue found in the search results (Issue #11412, dated April 27, 2018), the agent hallucinated a completely incorrect answer ("Wen Jia Bao") due to an internal content filtering error or failure to process the search results properly. This error derails the entire process because the next steps (finding contributors and matching names) depend entirely on knowing the correct version number. Furthermore, the agent prematurely declared a "FINAL ANSWER" without completing the logical steps of the plan.
